title: Vanderpump Rules
description: Sandoval attempts to reconnect with Scheana during a meditation exercise; Brock accuses a friend of spreading a rumor about his marriage; James and Ally announce their new family member to the world; Ariana and Katie embrace their inner bosses.

title: Vanderpump Rules
description: Schwartz makes a startling revelation to Lala about a past hookup that sends Katie spiraling; James hosts a DJ night at Hotel Ziggy; Ariana and Katie encounter new issues in opening their sandwich shop; Brock drops a bombshell about a recent liaison.

title: Property Brothers: Buying & Selling
description: A hardworking single mom who loves providing for her family, Jonie didn't hesitate when her eldest daughter, Taisha, asked to move back in with her own young daughter; while Jonie's heart is huge, her home isn't.

title: Property Brothers: Buying & Selling
description: A couple needs to find a larger house so that they can reunite their extended family under the same roof.

title: The Marc & Mandy Show
description: Marc and Mandy serve up the ultimate summer party with refreshing lemonade-inspired recipes.

title: Property Brothers: Buying & Selling
description: Craig and Simone want to move out of the suburbs and into a family home downtown, but their current home needs a complete overhaul.

title: Ella Enchanted
description: As a baby, Ella (Anne Hathaway) receives a visit from Lucinda (Vivica A. Fox), her fairy godmother, and is bestowed with a magical talent that requires her to obey anything that she is told to do. This proves to be more of a curse than a blessing, particularly once her mother dies and she is forced to live with the cruel Dame Olga (Joanna Lumley). Eventually, Ella embarks on a journey to find Lucinda and break the spell, accompanied by the handsome Prince Charmont (Hugh Dancy).

title: Pride & Prejudice
description: In this adaptation of Jane Austen's beloved novel, Elizabeth Bennet (Keira Knightley) lives with her mother, father and sisters in the English countryside. As the eldest, she faces mounting pressure from her parents to marry. When the outspoken Elizabeth is introduced to the handsome and upper-class Mr. Darcy (Matthew MacFadyen), sparks fly. Although there is obvious chemistry between the two, Darcy's overly reserved nature threatens the fledgling relationship.

title: The Greatest Showman
description: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

title: Backyard Builds
description: Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam and Kevin that matches their lush forest surroundings, complete with a double wrap-around deck and a hot tub; the team also builds a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

title: Definitely, Maybe
description: Will Hayes (Ryan Reynolds), a thirtysomething Manhattanite, is in the middle of divorce proceedings when his young daughter (Abigail Breslin) asks him about his life before marriage, including how he met and fell in love with her mother. Will flashes back to 1992 and recounts his romances with three women, changing their names so that his daughter must guess which one became his wife.

title: Kate & Leopold
description: Kate McKay (Meg Ryan) is a modern day executive, a 21st century woman driven to succeed in the corporate world. Leopold, the third Duke of Albany, is a charming gent and bachelor of the late 18OOs. With career and social expectations looming, each has grown cynical about the very notion of falling in love. But when a rip in the fabric of time thrusts Leopold into present day New York, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites.

title: The Best of Me
description: Amanda and Dawson, who were once high-school sweethearts, have a bittersweet reunion when they return to their hometown for the funeral of a mutual friend. Seeing each other again after 20 years apart reignites the love they've never forgotten, but Amanda and Dawson soon discover that the forces that drove them apart when they were younger pose even more threats today.
